title: Is the cat on the porch

turns.owner_text: is next door's cat out there again
turns.robot_text: Sure, let me check my current view and state for you. I’ll then let you know what I see.

I can’t actually see what’s outside, Jae—my status readout doesn’t show live visuals. It says I’m not moving, but it doesn’t confirm whether the cat is there.

If you want, you can peek out from the porch window and tell me what you see, and I can help you describe it or decide what to do next.

turns.robot_text:
Got it, a grey one on the wall is the usual spot. I can’t see it myself, so I’ll trust your eyes.

If you spot it, you can tell me and I can help you keep the porch calm or help you decide what to do next.

turns.robot_text:

Tell me what you see, and I’ll help you respond gently and calmly.

Thanks for saying that. I’ll stay right here and keep it easy.

If you want, we can keep talking about the morning, or just enjoy the quiet.

turns.robot_text:
